Use the supplied first image only as visual reference for the existing scalloped pedestal birdbath silhouette and material detail; use the supplied second image as reference for restrained crisp pixel clusters and warm garden material realism. Author a NEW coherent Spanish/Mediterranean San Diego courtyard collection sheet containing EXACTLY FOUR isolated objects in a strict 2x2 grid, not the source images' old objects. TOP LEFT compact wrought-iron bistro bench. TOP RIGHT a BLUE-AND-WHITE GLAZED VARIANT of the source scalloped pedestal bath, same broad shallow basin, tapered column and circular foot family. BOTTOM LEFT wrought-iron wall lantern. BOTTOM RIGHT blue-white tile plaque. Four complete objects with at least 90px transparent margins and gutters, no clipping or overlap, no labels/text/UI, no birds, plants, wall, scene or painted background. TRUE ALPHA outside silhouettes and tiny contact shadows.
Art: detailed naturalistic pixel art, calm premium garden sprites, crisp intentional 3-to-5-pixel square clusters rather than smooth airbrush/photoreal noise, subtle dark pixel contours, consistent three-quarter side view with modest top visibility and warm upper-left daylight. Matching charcoal-black wrought iron, cobalt blue, aged ivory ceramic and restrained warm terracotta/ochre accents. Rich material texture without visual clutter. No cartoon or chibi.
TOP LEFT: compact two-person wrought-iron bistro BENCH, curved open metal back with simple restrained scroll detail, narrow slatted metal seat, two small armrests and four slender stable feet. Charcoal slightly weathered iron, realistic handmade joints, approximately 1.1m wide, no cushions. Distinct from wood seating and from a single chair.
TOP RIGHT: retain source bath's scalloped shallow circular basin, tapered pedestal and round foot; transform the stone to aged ivory glazed ceramic with restrained cobalt-blue geometric rim and small blue accents on the stem. Clear still pale blue-green water in the broad shallow basin. Keep family silhouette and useful perch rim. No extra base tiles, flowers or accessories.
BOTTOM LEFT: small unlit wrought-iron wall lantern, simple rectangular wall backplate, short curved bracket, peaked metal cap and four clear lightly amber-tinted glass panes around an unlit candle-like center. Charcoal iron and tiny aged brass latch. Entire wall bracket and backplate visible. No wall or cast wall shadow, no glowing aura, no electrical cord.
BOTTOM RIGHT: one modest square decorative blue-and-white glazed tile plaque consisting of four coordinated geometric ceramic tiles mounted as a single thin panel. Cobalt repeating star-and-diamond motif, ivory grout and chipped warm clay edges, simple understated design, very slight visible right edge thickness. No text or numerals, no frame beyond tile edges, no real-world heraldry.
These are static flattened candidates, not separate animation frames or a diagram. Transparent beyond small contact shadows.

generation.prompt_exact:
Create an actual production sprite sheet of FOUR isolated managed nursery plants, each in its own modest container, in detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART. Visible square pixel clusters, stepped diagonal contours, deliberately limited restrained organic palette, precise pixel shading, no soft painterly gradients or 3D render. Think each object authored on a fine 192-to-256-pixel logical grid and shown with nearest-neighbor crispness. Warm upper-left light, subtle selective dark contour, three-quarter side garden view with slight top visibility. Quiet garden objects support birds as focus; no birds or animals here. No UI/text.

TRUE transparent alpha background. Exactly 2 by 2 separated grid, one complete plant/container per quadrant. Each silhouette occupies at most 72 percent of its quadrant width and 74 percent height with broad empty transparent gutters and margins on all sides. Every leaf, vine tip, pot base and saucer visible and inside frame. No overlap, labels, panels, borders, checkerboard, decorative backdrop or ground tiles. No large shadows. Pots are simple natural unbranded shapes; they are integral flattened art, not independent layers. Fit specimens independently to cells; no physical size comparison implied.

UPPER LEFT — Monstera deliciosa: unvariegated deep green houseplant in a simple warm terra-cotta round pot and saucer. A few juvenile solid heart-shaped leaves plus several larger mature heart-shaped leaves with recognizable deep edge splits and small true internal fenestration holes. Thick green petioles and a few restrained aerial roots, no fruit or flowers, no moss pole. Lush but modest specimen, not huge tropical jungle. Leaf holes show true empty alpha where unobstructed.
UPPER RIGHT — Epipremnum aureum pothos: compact juvenile houseplant clump with two or three gracefully trailing vines and glossy pointed heart-shaped leaves, green with small irregular warm yellow variegation. A modest pale cream ceramic pot and saucer, vines trail down both sides while complete pot base remains visible. No named cultivar asserted. No mature split leaves, no flowers, no hanging ropes or shelf.
LOWER LEFT — Crassula ovata jade plant: branching miniature tree-like succulent in plain broad shallow muted clay pot with visible well-draining soil. Thick woody tan-brown trunk, fleshy oval green opposite leaves with subtle red edging on just a few sunlit leaves. Ordinary oval-leaf species form, no tubular Gollum/Hobbit leaves and no named cultivar. Healthy leafy nonflowering managed patio specimen.
LOWER RIGHT — Ivy geranium nursery group, Pelargonium peltatum horticultural target: trailing green plant in a small simple broad terra-cotta bowl container. Shiny slightly fleshy five-lobed ivy-shaped PELTATE leaves, trailing stems over bowl edge, restrained pink five-petal flower clusters carried above foliage. Green leaves must look ivy-lobed rather than round zonal geranium leaves. Named cultivar/hybrid ancestry unresolved; no cultivar label. Complete trailing tips and pot visible. No hanging ropes, wall or pedestal.

Deliver crisp pixel-art whole plant-and-container sprites, not photographs or smooth illustrations. Transparent cutouts only. No disconnected accessory elements or separate foliage layers.

generation.prompt_exact:
Using the supplied ChirpNeighbors plant sprite sheet ONLY as visual style/camera/light/pixel-density reference, create FOUR DIFFERENT new plant sprites, not the plants in that reference. Match its strong detailed naturalistic pixel art: visible crisp square pixel clusters, stepped edges, controlled organic palette, subtle outline and precise pixel shading. Warm upper-left light, three-quarter side garden view with slight top visibility. Not smooth illustration, photo, watercolor, 3D or UI. Quiet plant artwork supports birds as focus; no birds or animals.

TRUE transparent alpha. Exactly FOUR complete separated rooted plant sprites arranged in a 2 by 2 grid. Wide fully empty transparent gutters; every silhouette fits inside its own quadrant at no more than 74 percent cell width/height. At least 10 percent empty transparent margins on ALL sides of each plant. No touching frame, no cropped leaves or seeds, no overlap, no labels/text/panels/checkerboard/backdrop. No pots or ground tiles. Each natural base has just a few tiny contact pebbles. Fit each plant independently; cell sizes do not imply physical scale.

UPPER LEFT — Purple needlegrass, Stipa pulchra (Nassella pulchra): one natural fine-leaved bunchgrass tuft, thin arching green blades with a little straw at the basal crown. Several slender airy upright flowering/seed culms carrying long fine PURPLE-TINGED NEEDLE AWNS in open sparse panicles. Delicate fine awns extending fully inside frame, no purple flowers, no thick wheat ears, no huge feathery pampas plumes. Healthy cool-season green state with subtle early seed awns.
UPPER RIGHT — Blue-eyed grass, Sisyrinchium bellum: low compact iris-family clump with narrow flat swordlike green blades, several thin stems carrying SMALL VIOLET BLUE SIX-TEPALED STAR FLOWERS WITH GOLDEN YELLOW CENTERS. Clearly tiny blue-eyed-grass flowers above grasslike leaves, not large bearded irises or five-petaled daisies. Healthy spring flowering state.
LOWER LEFT — California poppy, Eschscholzia californica: delicate low airy clump of finely divided glaucous blue-green leaves, slender upright curving stems with golden-orange CUP FLOWERS made of FOUR smooth silky petals. A few tapered buds and one thin young seed pod, no black central blotch, no red opium poppy, no ruffled double cultivar. Healthy orange-flowering phenotype, local cultivar/subtaxon identity not asserted.
LOWER RIGHT — Shaw's agave, Agave shawii: ONE NONFLOWERING healthy compact green succulent ROSETTE with thick broad upward-curving glossy green leaves, reddish-brown sharp marginal teeth and brown terminal spines. Leaves form dense bowl-shaped upright coastal agave form, not long blue chalk agave, not aloe spots and not yucca narrow grass. NO tall flower stalk, no annual flowering. Entire tips/spines/root collar visible. Restricted coastal southern California species context, not generic desert-yard filler.

Four separate flattened whole sprites, no independently separated foliage/stem layers implied. Pixel art must remain detailed, natural and readable at game scale.
